title.narrative: Mizoram Health Systems Strengthening Project in India

description.narrative: UNOPS provides procurement services to strengthen the public health facilities across Mizoram state under the World Bank funded Mizoram Health System Strengthening Program (MHSSP). The Mizoram Health Systems Strengthening Project will benefit the people across all eight districts of the state. It will also benefit health sector staff, specifically at the secondary and primary levels, by strengthening their planning and management capacity along with building their clinical skills and competencies. The agreed list of equipment, primarily for Reproductive and Child Health and Neonatal Care will be supplied to the District Hospitals, Primary Health Centers, and Community Health Centers. In addition, UNOPS will also procure and supply IT equipment: computers, printers, copiers. UNOPS scope includes the sourcing, supplying, installing (wherever required) of the equipment and training regarding operation of the equipment to the end-users. \n
